name: graphify-reviewer
description: Autonomous agentic code review: integrates Claude Code, Graphify, SonarQube CLI, and Nexus IQ CLI into a unified review pipeline.

graphifyReviewer.claudePath.description: Absolute path to the Claude Code CLI executable. Leave empty to resolve 'claude' from the system PATH.

graphifyReviewer.sonarPath.description: Absolute path to the sonar-scanner executable. Leave empty to resolve 'sonar-scanner' from the system PATH.

graphifyReviewer.nexusIqPath.description: Absolute path to the Nexus IQ CLI executable. Leave empty to resolve 'nexus-iq-cli' from the system PATH.

graphifyReviewer.graphifyPath.description: Absolute path to the Graphify CLI executable. Leave empty to resolve 'graphify' from the system PATH.
